title: Depth-five homogeneous lower bounds for iterated matrix multiplication
exact_target: Must every syntactically homogeneous depth-five $\Sigma \Pi \Sigma \Pi \Sigma $ circuit over C computing the (1,1) entry of a product of n independent n×n variable matrices have size at least $n^{c\surd n}$ for some $c>0$ and all sufficiently large n?
